```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(BSgenome)
library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)
library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.NCBI.T2TCHM13v2.0)

source(here::here("scripts", "GuideRefine-functions.R"))
source(here::here("scripts", "CRISPR-KO-library-survey-functions.R"))
```

# Control terms (per-library) used for the real filtering step below

```{r}
# [PLAN B, D5 fix] per-library control terms, verified against each library's
# actual raw gene column -- a single generic list silently missed Jacquere's
# NO_SITE/ONE_SITE_INTERGENIC (note: correct word order, the old list here had
# "ONE_INTERGENIC_SITE" which never matched the real data) and TKOv3's EGFP.
# The REAL filtering happens inside import_sgrna_library_alignment() below,
# not a separate import_sgrna_library() call -- a version of this fix that
# only patched the latter was previously dead code (nothing downstream ever
# read its output), confirmed by the classification row-count gap.
generic_terms <- c("CONTROL", "Control", "control", "INTRON", "Intron", "intron", "LacZ", "luciferase")
terms_for_filtering_tkov3 <- paste(c(generic_terms, "EGFP"), collapse = "|")
terms_for_filtering_jacquere <- paste(c(generic_terms, "NO_SITE", "ONE_SITE_INTERGENIC"), collapse = "|")
terms_for_filtering <- paste(generic_terms, collapse = "|")
```

# For T2T-CHM13 use this chunk code

```{r}

annotation <- here::here("data", "annotation", "T2T-CHM13v2.0_gene_annot_granges.rds")
genome_type_version <- "T2T-CHM13"
bsgenome <- BSgenome.Hsapiens.NCBI.T2TCHM13v2.0

# T2T-CHM13
avana_alignment_meyers <- import_sgrna_library_alignment(here::here("data", "sgrna_lfc_data", "avana_data", "avana_library_aln.csv"), genome_type_version, terms_for_filtering)
brunello_alignment <- import_sgrna_library_alignment(here::here("data", "sgrna_lfc_data", "brunello_data", "broadgpp-brunello-library-contents_aln.csv"), genome_type_version, terms_for_filtering)
toronto_alignment <- import_sgrna_library_alignment(here::here("data", "sgrna_lfc_data", "tkov3_data", "tkov3_guide_sequence_aln.csv"), genome_type_version, terms_for_filtering_tkov3)
yusa_alignment <- import_sgrna_library_alignment(here::here("data", "sgrna_lfc_data", "yusa_data", "yusa_hcrispr_ko_grnas_aln.csv"), genome_type_version, terms_for_filtering)
jacquere_alignment <- import_sgrna_library_alignment(here::here("data", "sgrna_lfc_data", "jacquere_data", "Jacquere_PerGuideAnnotations_Quota4_aln.csv"), genome_type_version, terms_for_filtering_jacquere)

# list_removed_sgrna sgRNAs -- from the fresh restricted-library GuideRefine re-run (Jul2026), not the old May2026 unrestricted one
disposed_avana <- import_list_off_target_guides(here::here("data", "guiderefine_output", "Jul2026_T2T-CHM13", "avana_library_disposed_sgRNAs.tsv"))
disposed_brunello <- import_list_off_target_guides(here::here("data", "guiderefine_output", "Jul2026_T2T-CHM13", "broadgpp-brunello-library-contents_disposed_sgRNAs.tsv"))
disposed_toronto <- import_list_off_target_guides(here::here("data", "guiderefine_output", "Jul2026_T2T-CHM13", "tkov3_guide_sequence_disposed_sgRNAs.tsv"))
disposed_yusa <- import_list_off_target_guides(here::here("data", "guiderefine_output", "Jul2026_T2T-CHM13", "yusa_hcrispr_ko_grnas_disposed_sgRNAs.tsv"))
disposed_jacquere <- import_list_off_target_guides(here::here("data", "guiderefine_output", "Jul2026_T2T-CHM13", "Jacquere_PerGuideAnnotations_Quota4_disposed_sgRNAs.tsv"))

```

# Classify the sgRNAs in each libraries

```{r}

# off_target_classification() has three arguments, the second one is looking for PAM-distal single mismatch, you can turn this off by put it as NA. Therefore the PAM-distal single mismatch will be considered as single mismatch sgRNA

avana_classification <- off_target_classification(avana_alignment_meyers,
                                                  NA,
                                                  disposed_avana["pam_distal_double_mismatch_guides"])
write_csv(avana_classification[[1]], here::here("data", "sgrna_lfc_data", "avana_data", "avana_sgrna_alignment_classification_T2T.csv"))

brunello_classification <- off_target_classification(brunello_alignment,
                                                     NA,
                                                     disposed_brunello["pam_distal_double_mismatch_guides"])
write_csv(brunello_classification[[1]], here::here("data", "sgrna_lfc_data", "brunello_data", "brunello_sgrna_alignment_classification_T2T.csv"))

toronto_classification <- off_target_classification(toronto_alignment,
                                                    NA,
                                                    disposed_toronto["pam_distal_double_mismatch_guides"])

write_csv(toronto_classification[[1]], here::here("data", "sgrna_lfc_data", "tkov3_data", "tkov3_sgrna_alignment_classification_T2T.csv"))

yusa_classification <- off_target_classification(yusa_alignment,
                                                 NA,
                                                 disposed_yusa["pam_distal_double_mismatch_guides"])

write_csv(yusa_classification[[1]], here::here("data", "sgrna_lfc_data", "yusa_data", "yusa_sgrna_alignment_classification_T2T.csv"))

jacquere_classification <- off_target_classification(jacquere_alignment,
                                                     NA,
                                                     disposed_jacquere["pam_distal_double_mismatch_guides"])

write_csv(jacquere_classification[[1]], here::here("data", "sgrna_lfc_data", "jacquere_data", "jacquere_sgrna_alignment_classification_T2T.csv"))

```

# For hg38 use this chunk code

```{r}

genome_type_version_hg38 <- "hg38"
bsgenome_hg38 <- BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38

# hg38
avana_alignment_meyers_hg38 <- import_sgrna_library_alignment(here::here("data", "sgrna_lfc_data", "hg38_alignment", "avana_library_aln.csv"), genome_type_version_hg38, terms_for_filtering)

yusa_alignment_hg38 <- import_sgrna_library_alignment(here::here("data", "sgrna_lfc_data", "hg38_alignment", "yusa_hcrispr_ko_grnas_aln.csv"), genome_type_version_hg38, terms_for_filtering)
jacquere_alignment_hg38 <- import_sgrna_library_alignment(here::here("data", "sgrna_lfc_data", "hg38_alignment", "Jacquere_PerGuideAnnotations_Quota4_aln.csv"), genome_type_version_hg38, terms_for_filtering_jacquere)

# list_removed_sgrna sgRNAs
disposed_avana_hg38 <- import_list_off_target_guides(here::here("data", "guiderefine_output", "hg38", "avana_library_disposed_sgRNAs.tsv"))
disposed_brunello_hg38 <- import_list_off_target_guides(here::here("data", "guiderefine_output", "hg38", "broadgpp-brunello-library-contents_disposed_sgRNAs.tsv"))

```
